themes.description: Users consistently report that the customer service is unresponsive, slow, and lacking in helpful assistance.
themes.business_impact: High customer churn due to unresolved issues, increased negative word‑of‑mouth, and loss of trust leading to revenue decline from subscription cancellations.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support team suffers from inadequate staffing, insufficient training, and poor ticket‑routing processes, combined with reliance on automated AI help that is not effectively integrated.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit current support staffing and SLA
• Expand live agent roster to reduce wait times by 50%
• Implement ticket escalation matrix with real‑time SLA monitoring
• Create comprehensive knowledge base and train agents
• Deploy chat monitoring to detect failures early
• Collect quarterly customer satisfaction surveys
• Allocate budget for support tools and analytics
• Communicate improvements to customers and rebuild trust

themes.description: Users report that sell orders often get stuck in pending or fail to execute, and withdrawal and refund requests are delayed or missing, causing frustration and financial loss.
themes.business_impact: Loss of active trader engagement, increased churn risk among frequent traders, potential regulatory scrutiny over delayed payouts, and a spike in support tickets that drain resources.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The platform’s order routing to exchanges is experiencing latency or misrouting, the withdrawal processing pipeline has bottlenecks or missing state transitions, and the UI obscures status updates, leading users to believe orders are pending or funds are missing.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Audit and optimize order routing latency and failure handling
• 2. Implement real‑time order status updates and error alerts
• 3. Redesign withdrawal processing pipeline to guarantee 24‑hour turnaround
• 4. Add a retry/fallback mechanism for failed sell orders
• 5. Provide transparent fee and refund breakdowns in the UI
• 6. Load test the end‑to‑end trade and withdrawal flow
• 7. Communicate changes and educate users via in‑app messages
